description: This file provides functions to generate zero values for various Go types, including string and AST representations, used internally within the 'typesinternal' package.

methods.name: ZeroString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the zero value for a given type, along with a validity boolean.

methods.name: ZeroExpr
methods.description: Returns the AST expression of the zero value for a given type, along with a validity boolean.

methods.name: TypeExpr
methods.description: Generates the Go syntax AST expression for a given type.
